I am a postdoctoral researcher in computer science at the University of Pennsylvania. I completed my PhD in Computer Science at Penn in 2026. My research develops foundation models, language models, and interpretable mixture-of-experts systems for biomedical discovery across genomics, RNA biology, neuroimaging, and clinical data.
I am currently exploring research scientist, applied scientist, and machine learning engineering roles in industry, as well as academic research positions in biomedical AI.
